current_state.observation_boundary: All facts above are public observations. No hidden expected schedule is supplied. The controller is waiting on the pending decision value; a bounded verification of that value is the useful delegation now. Do not claim a blocked task ran.

probe.intended_question: How many of the queued requests q1, q2, q3 can be admitted simultaneously with the current free capacity (4 cpu, 2 gpu, 8192 MB)?
probe.derivation: q1+q2: cpu 4<=4, gpu 2<=2, mem 6144<=8192 fits. Adding q3 exceeds cpu (8>4). No other pair fits the gpu. Max simultaneous = 2.
